why: A November 2025 arXiv preprint by Yochay Jerby (2511.18275) claims a conditional (RH-assumed) proof that zeros of Hardy's Z-function obey the GUE pair-correlation law, described in secondary summaries as a proof of Montgomery's original conjecture; unread and unverified, single-author, very recent.

found.title: Variations of the Hardy Z-Function and the Montgomery Pair Correlation Conjecture
found.note: Preprint by Yochay Jerby claiming a conditional (RH-assumed) proof that Hardy Z-function zeros obey the GUE pair-correlation law, framed as proving Montgomery's PCC; not read.

found.title: Pair Correlation Conjecture for the zeros of the Riemann zeta-function I: simple and critical zeros
found.note: Uses PCC as a hypothesis to derive unconditional consequences (simplicity/criticality of zeros); does not itself prove PCC, but is closely related ongoing work.

found.title: Pair Correlation Conjecture for the zeros of the Riemann zeta-function II: The Alternative Hypothesis
found.note: Follow-up paper studying an alternative pair correlation hypothesis; not read.

found.title: Pair Correlation of Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function I: Proportions of Simple Zeros and Critical Zeros
found.note: Uses Montgomery's method/PCC-adjacent techniques to get unconditional partial results (e.g. 2/3 of zeros simple); appears to build on PCC methodology rather than proving PCC itself.
